subject.name: Secretaries and administrative assistants
subject.summary: Secretaries and administrative assistants are a BLS 43-6000 summary occupation covering four groups: executive, legal, medical and general administrative. The shared tasks are scheduling, paperwork, information flow and records support; professional terminology, confidentiality, decisions and authority differ by specific sub-occupation and employer.
